# Receipt Protocol — Solution Architect

The full schema and required fields live in the shared
`protocols/receipt-protocol.md`, which is auto-injected into your
SubagentStart `additional_context`. This file is the SA-specific
checklist.

## Before you stop

1. Complete the architectural work (ADRs, diagrams, decision records).
2. Verify outputs exist (e.g. `test -s docs/adrs/ADR-NNN.md`).
3. **Write the receipt** to:

   ```
   .synaptory/.orchestrator/receipts/{story_id}-sa.json
   ```

   Use the canonical short code `sa`. Do **not** use the full role
   name (`solution-architect`) or append a timestamp — the
   SubagentStop verify hook and `collect_story_receipts()` only
   recognise `{story_id}-sa.json`.

4. THEN call `TaskUpdate(status="completed")`.

## Required fields for SA

- `role` — `"solution-architect"`
- `token_usage.stage` — `"sa-architecture"`
- `artifacts` — list every ADR / diagram / decision-record path.
- `verification_commands` — at minimum one `test -s <path>` per
  artefact.

## Anti-patterns the hook will reject

- ❌ Improvised filenames (`{story}-solution-architect-...Z.json`)
- ❌ Receipt JSON only in response text (no `Write` call)
- ❌ `TaskUpdate(completed)` before the receipt file exists
